title: Design Patent: ZeroTrace — CyberSecurity Audit & Multipurpose Device Enclosure
abstract: Official Design Patent Application (Application No: 499678-001, CBR NO: 209757) filed in April 2026. Protects the unique industrial design, integrated ST7735 full-color display bezel, 5-way joystick navigation layout, high-gain 2.4 GHz RF transceiver mounts, and ergonomic pocket-sized form factor for the ZeroTrace cybersecurity auditing companion.
